name: Bangyaru!!
source:
Daito was the vocalist for a not-exactly-famous Visual Kei band called "Laprimastra"...
One day he was approached by unlikely fans.
"You're the lead for Laprimastra, right?"
"Y-yeah... sorry..."
"That last concert was brilliant. I'm a fan now!"
"...Really!?"
Goth loli Anon, boyish girl Chelka and mysterious beauty Julie...
Daito has fans at last! What will he do with his groupies?

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE081635.html]DLsite[/url]]
translation:
戴特是一支名为“拉普里玛斯特拉”的名不见经传的视觉系乐队的主唱……
某天，几名意想不到的粉丝主动找上了他。
“你是拉普里玛斯特拉的主唱，对吧？”
“是、是啊……抱歉……”
“上一场演出棒极了。我现在是你们的粉丝！”
“……真的吗？！”
哥特洛丽塔少女阿侬、假小子切露卡，以及神秘美女朱莉……
戴特终于拥有了粉丝！面对这群女粉丝，他会做什么？

[引自[url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE081635.html]DLsite[/url]]
